game.name: Capitan Sevilla - El Remake
game.desc: Remake of Dinamic's 1988 classic by Computeremuzone Games Studio. Mariano Lopez, a sausage delivery man, eats radioactive blood sausages and becomes Captain 'S', who has to save Seville from the evil Dr. Torrebruno. Switch between Mariano and the flying superhero across a large platform adventure.
